svg.title: CYC Stack team workflow
svg.desc: Your AI assistant reuses and revalidates project knowledge, builds a focused change and retains useful findings before final checks, proves applicable tests against original code, runs configured checks and reviews consumers, then delivers evidence and context pointers. The local controller checks records and executes project commands; an active host hook enforces delivery. Failed checks return to repair within the retry budget. Teams share through their existing project review process; run logs are local by default.
svg.text: CYC STACK / TEAM WORKFLOW
Shared project knowledge. Reviewable AI changes.
Describe the outcome. Your AI assistant selects the relevant methods through /cyc.
PROJECT KNOWLEDGE IN YOUR REPO
Reuse matched decisions, constraints, failed approaches and check recipes.
Revalidate current code. Keep useful verified facts; label proposals and record acceptance for adopted decisions.
Read + revalidate
Retain before final checks
1. SCOUT
Understand the change
Read relevant history.Trace affected paths.Set criteria and checks.
2. BUILD
Make a focused change
Change one useful slice.Check affected behavior.Retain useful findings.
3. VERIFY
Establish current evidence
Original-code proof.*Your configured checks.Intent + consumer review.
4. DELIVER
Leave a useful handoff
Outcome and limits.A generated review.Useful context pointers.
Failed checks return to repair within the same retry budget.
The assistant does the engineering. Code checks the recorded evidence.
LOCAL CONTROLLER
Scope, current file evidence and retry budgets.Runs the project’s configured commands.
ACTIVE HOST HOOK
Enforces delivery when the hook is active.A ready result or an honest blocked handoff.
* Original-code proof for applicable feature, bug-fix and refactor runs; exemptions are recorded.
Your team reviews and shares. Publication requires authorization.
Run logs stay local by default. Share useful project docs and review evidence through your normal process.
